note: The last 64 bytes of the attacker-controlled font file are copied into text32 as 16 UTF-32 codepoints. This is the attacker-controlled text input that will be shaped.
The 16 UTF-32 codepoints are added to the hb_buffer_t. The codepoints include Arabic combining marks (U+0654, U+0344, U+0320) which will trigger the Arabic shaper path.
The script is guessed from the buffer contents. The Arabic combining marks cause the script to be set to HB_SCRIPT_ARABIC, which selects the Arabic shaper with reorder_marks_arabic.
The shaping pipeline is invoked, which eventually calls _hb_ot_shape_normalize on the buffer containing the Arabic text with combining marks.
clear_output sets out_len=0 and out_info=info, preparing the output buffer for the decompose round. The output buffer will be filled during decomposition.

swap_buffers exchanges info and out_info pointers and swaps len/out_len. After this, info points to the decomposed output (len = output length), and out_info points to the old input buffer (out_len = old input length). The out_info buffer may be shorter than the info buffer if decomposition expanded the text.
The combining marks in the cluster are sorted by combining class. This reorders the marks in the info buffer, but out_info still reflects the pre-sort state.
For the Arabic script, this dispatches to reorder_marks_arabic with start=i and end=end, where i and end are indices into the current info buffer.

reorder_marks_arabic calls merge_out_clusters with start and j as indices into the info buffer. However, merge_out_clusters operates on the out_info buffer. When j exceeds out_len (the old input length), it will read uninitialized out_info entries. Debug instrumentation confirmed start=15, end=17, out_len=16, so out_info[16] is read uninitialized.
Reads the cluster value from out_info[start]. Since start=15 and out_len=16, this is within bounds, but the subsequent loop will read out of bounds.

The loop iterates i from start+1 to end-1, reading out_info[i].cluster. With start=15, end=17, out_len=16, the iteration i=16 reads out_info[16] which is beyond out_len and contains uninitialized memory.

set_cluster is called on out_info[i] for i in [start, end). For i=16, this passes the uninitialized out_info[16] entry to set_cluster, which reads info.cluster and info.mask from uninitialized memory, triggering the MemorySanitizer use-of-uninitialized-value report.

set_cluster reads info.cluster and info.mask from the uninitialized out_info[16] entry. The comparison info.cluster != cluster and the mask manipulation read uninitialized values, which is the memory-safety sink detected by MSAN.
